messages:
sylvie: Final prep for next Tue announce. Need ENG to lock canonical changelog URL + a single landing redirect. Also confirm canary cadence and PD owners. Target announce Tue 09:00 PT. Any press-embargo asks?
otto: I'll push the changelog and the redirect page by EOD. Marketing wants the landing to point to: release-notes, migration-checklist, and webinar reg anchor — single short URL pls.
rija: Adding a short benchmark blurb for the announcement: "avg token cost down 18% in our web-service benchmark vs previous release". Will put numbers in the blog. Also want a rehearsal slot for webinar demo.
osps-bot: infra-bot: canary plan suggestion: 09:00 PT 15m dark-canary (no traffic unless signaled) -> 30m live canary at 10% -> ramp to 50% over 45m -> hold 60m -> full at +2:00 if green. Rollback triggers: 5xx >0.15% for 5m OR p95 latency +12% vs baseline. PD: eng-oncall -> otto, eng-sre -> mika.
press-bot: press-ops: embargo window requested 24h for select reporters. Marketing to handle press preview link; confirm we have private preview URL for docs.
sylvie: Good catch. Can we host a private preview of the docs landing at /preview/release-2024-11 for press?
otto: yes, will create preview token and share with press list. Also adding anchors: #whats-new, #migration, #webinar. Final changelog URL will be: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2024-11/changelog.html (live by 17:00 PT).
rija: Webinar asks: 30s teaser blurb + a 2-sentence headline for the email. Also need timezone conversions for PT/CEST/HKT.
sylvie: Messaging AB test subjects (12h): A) "Reduce inference costs with new rollout tooling" B) "Ship LLM updates safely  canaries, benchmarks, and migration guides". Tweet-sized copy pls.
otto: Tweet: "New release: smarter batching, KV cache, and safer canaries to lower cost and risk. Read + register: https://events.redwood.ai/nov2024"
osps-bot: staging form payload sample for inbound routing:
```http
POST /api/register
Headers: {"Content-Type":"application/json","X-Region":"NA","X-UTM":"nov-announce"}
Body: {"email":"jane@example.com","company":"Acme"}
```
sylvie: Sales routing map: NA->sdr-na, EMEA->sdr-emea, APAC->sdr-apac. If >80/day for any region, forward to growth@.
rija: I'll draft the benchmark narrative + 3-bullet "what's new" callout and drop it here by 4pm PT. Also scheduling a webinar dry-run on Mon 16:00 PT.
sylvie: Perfect. Marketing will bundle assets (tweet, two subject lines, header image, press preview token) and post final announce packet by 20:00 PT. Thanks all :rocket:
